description: One Robinhood Chain pool by Uniswap v4 pool id or v3 pool address (path parameter id, from /v1/rh/pools/new). Returns 1-minute buckets for the last 60 minutes (net ETH, buy ETH, sell ETH, buy and sell swap counts) and the pool's burst history. Untracked pools answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

id.description: Uniswap v4 pool id (bytes32 hex) or v3 pool address, from rh_pools_new

name: rh_pool_flow
